messages:
Sam: Quick check — need a short overnight SKU swap for a demo. Can we borrow a UK-West H100 slot (soft hold) from Vendor B between 02:00-05:00 UTC? Running a lightweight inference smoke + a 1hr live demo.
Jia: Which tenant / cost center will this be billed to? Need PR + cost tag before we touch quota.
Oliver: uk-west currently shows 2 soft-hold slots available. Vendor B requires a lease-back note and reservation id. If you only need 1 slot we can do a quick swap.
vendor-bot: vendor-bot: Reservation lookup: Vendor B — 2 standby slots in uk-west until 2026-03-17 05:00 UTC. Reply with `reservation_id` to claim or provide a PR link for ops to proceed.
Karen: Ops checklist in-thread: 1) open a terraform PR to infra/allocations, 2) add billing tag `cost_center`, 3) include `company-assign` tag for vendor, 4) ping oncall if demo goes beyond window.
Sam: Ack — opening PR now. Terraform snippet:```hcl
module "swap" {
  source = "infra/alloc"
  tenant = "demo-team"
  sku    = "h100-uk-west"
  count  = 1
}
```
Jia: Also confirm runtime: `dedicated` vs `burst`? Dedicated needs SLA signoff, burst is faster to approve for short demos.
Sam: Burst is fine for this demo — low token load, no SLA change required.
Oliver: Vendor DMd — they can hold 1 slot for you but need `company-assign` and cost center. Also asked for expected release time in case of overrun.
Sam: PR created: https://git.company/repo/pull/1234. Added `cost_center = "CC-INFR-19"` and `company-assign = "demo-team"`. Vendor provided reservation_id `VB-98321`. Marking allocated and will release by 05:00 UTC, will ping if overrun. :thumbsup:
